purpose: library: the idea of a function through exponential, logarithmic and trigonometric examples, with a worked similar-triangles demonstration that cos(b) = x/y = 2x/2y = 3x/3y depends only on the angle and not on the side lengths. Fits quiz cards (predict the ratio when the sides double or triple), a compare table (black/red/blue triangles), and the formula explorer for cos(b) = a/h.
